_metadata.description: Strategic organization and integration guide for feed-in tariff data

file_1_feed_in_tariffs.json.purpose: Complete tariff data source - contains all pricing tables and tiers
file_1_feed_in_tariffs.json.structure: fixed_and_variable_contracts (18 providers) + dynamic_contracts (4 strategies) + reference tables
file_1_feed_in_tariffs.json.use_case: Detailed lookup when you need exact pricing for a specific provider and kWh volume

file_2_feed_in_tariff_methods.json.purpose: Reference index and calculation method documentation
file_2_feed_in_tariff_methods.json.structure: provider_index (24 entries) + calculation_guides (4 types) + dynamic_strategies (4 approaches)
file_2_feed_in_tariff_methods.json.use_case: Quick reference: 'What method does provider X use?' or 'How do I calculate cost for method Y?'

file_3_feed_in_lookup_integration.json.purpose: Quick lookup tables and implementation templates
file_3_feed_in_lookup_integration.json.structure: provider_tariff_summary (by method and coverage) + lookup_helpers + integration patterns
file_3_feed_in_lookup_integration.json.use_case: Integration with ingest_tariffs.py - pre-computed summaries and function templates

new_columns: feed_in_applicable: boolean (true if fixed/variable contract with solar)
feed_in_calculation_method: string (one of: tiered_staffels, fixed_rate_per_kwh, fixed_fee_plus_variable, higher_fixed_rate)
feed_in_cost_annual_eur_estimate: float64 (estimated yearly cost for 3000 kWh)

phase_2_populate_metadata.logic: For each row: provider_id → lookup provider_index → extract calculation_method and store

phase_3_calculate_estimates.logic:
For each contract:
  - If fixed/variable AND solar: use estimate_feedin_cost(provider_id, contract_duration, 3000 or actual_kwh)
  - Store result in feed_in_cost_annual_eur_estimate

phase_4_dynamic_contract_enrichment.logic: For dynamic contracts: lookup dynamic_handling strategy and note whether customer receives or pays

phase_5_validation_and_reporting.logic: Check against example values in feed_in_lookup_integration.json scenarios

data_flow_diagram.description: How data flows through the three JSON files
flow: User needs feed-in cost for: provider_id='eneco', contract_duration='1_jaar', annual_kwh=5000
→ Confirms ~1704 for 12000 kWh proportional to our 730 for 5000 kWh ✓

use_case_1_exact_cost_lookup.question: What is the exact feed-in cost for 3500 kWh at Vandebron 1-year contract?
query_sequence: Find tier where 3500 >= kwh_min AND 3500 <= kwh_max
→ Should fall in tier {kwh_min: 3500, kwh_max: 3750} → cost: 543.72 EUR

use_case_2_provider_comparison.question: Which fixed/variable providers have the cheapest feed-in rates for 5000 kWh?

use_case_3_dynamic_strategy.question: Should I switch to a dynamic contract? Which is best for solar owners?
query_sequence: → Energiedirect, Essent, Vattenfall, Eneco, Tibber (you pay only on overage, neutral)
→ EasyEnergy, NextEnergy, Pure Energie, Innova (you pay on all, negative)

use_case_4_integration_into_ingest.question: How do I add feed-in cost calculation to ingest_tariffs.py?
query_sequence: Update get_contracts_schema() to include new field (nullable float64)

contract_type_to_tariff_section.dynamic: Look in dynamic_contracts section, not fixed_and_variable

calculation_method_to_function.tiered_staffels: Find bracket, return bracket's yearly cost
calculation_method_to_function.higher_fixed_rate: Use example data to estimate relative impact

before_production_integration: ✓ All 24 provider IDs mapped to data sources
✓ Calculation methods verified against provider websites
✓ Example costs in lookup_integration match calculated values
✓ Tiered brackets start at correct kWh threshold
✓ Contract duration mappings consistent (1_jaar vs 1-year, etc)
✓ Large provider tiers (Vandebron 10K+) noted as incomplete
after_production_deployment: ✓ Provider coverage validated (all providers in data exist)
✓ Cost sorting/ranking queries return sensible results

vandebron_tiers_incomplete.issue: Vandebron has tiers beyond 10,000 kWh available in PDF
vandebron_tiers_incomplete.solution: Capture PDF and add to feed_in_tariffs.json tiers array
vandebron_tiers_incomplete.temporary_approach: For 10K+ kWh, use linear extrapolation from last tier

coolblue_hidden_costs.issue: Coolblue doesn't show separate feed-in costs; included in base fee
coolblue_hidden_costs.solution: Use example data (€280/year for ~1800kWh) to estimate impact
coolblue_hidden_costs.note: Feed-in costs might not be separately queryable; may need to use higher_fixed_rate logic

dynamic_contract_complexity.issue: Dynamic contracts have different compensation/charge models per provider
dynamic_contract_complexity.solution: Always check dynamic_handling field before calculating
dynamic_contract_complexity.risk: Mixing up suppliers on dynamic side can heavily impact customer savings

future_enhancement_opportunities.seasonal_variations: Some providers may have seasonal tariffs (not captured yet)
future_enhancement_opportunities.solar_size_brackets: Some providers might offer different rates based on installation size
future_enhancement_opportunities.regional_differences: Some provinces/regions may have different tariff structures
future_enhancement_opportunities.contract_amendments: Track tariff changes over time (current data: Dec 2025)

future_enhancement_opportunities.cost_trend_analysis: Historical tracking would show price evolution patterns
